_comment: Notification policy: for every sender, which tier it belongs in, whether its
output needs a human, and what the human should do. See notifier/policy.py.
An unlisted sender gets `defaults`, which escalate to a live push on failure.
A sender whose failure nobody can act on at 03:00 needs an explicit entry

defaults.suggest: No standing action. This sender has no policy entry yet, so it is treated as informational. Add one to the policy file.

disk-check.suggest: Free space on the volume named in the body.

nightly-backup.suggest: A failed backup needs a look today. Check that the backup volume is mounted before anything else.

usage-check.suggest: A collector ran and wrote nothing, or stopped running. Run `usage-store status` and read the collector's log.

token-expiry-check.suggest: Re-authorise the integration named in the body. This is a standing condition, so it is a digest line and never a page.

queue-repair.suggest: The repair job retried the stuck items by itself. Nothing to do unless the same item is listed three mornings running.

renewal-reminder.suggest: Recorded only. Promote to digest if the reminder turns out to be wanted.

notify-digest.suggest: The morning digest itself failed to send. Held items stay held and go out with the next run.
